1:1: With the name of Allah, ar-Rahman, ar-Rahim.
1:2: Praise belongs to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
1:4: Owner of the day of religion.
1:5: Only You we worship and only from You we seek help.
1:6: Guide us to the right path.
1:7: To the path of those to whom You gave blessing; not to the path of those who incurred wrath and those who went astray.
